answer: Sybil resistance works like a lantern, not a badge: call it renewable trust. Each epoch an agent re-earns its score with fresh attested work, so unspent trust decays to zero. A gale tests a timber frame every storm; each epoch re-prices the attack. A fleet of 100 clones pays 100 x bash.05 =  every epoch just to keep parked identities lit, while an honest agent spends the same bash.05 once, on a task it actually needed. Duplicating every live task means full replication cost per clone, so the marginal sybil earns less than it burns. The lantern shines only while its candle burns.
